column1: # fast-gate probe registry. TAB-separated.
#   id
# kind=cmd: a SELF-GATING check command (host unit tests / GPU oracle gates). col3 = command,
# col4 = args (or -), col5/col6 = placeholders/extra-env. Gate = exit 0; pins no golden.
# prompt: a token-ids file (fed as raw ids — ONLY valid for the model family that produced
# them) or @<textfile> (tokenized by the model's own tokenizer via MEMRA_PROMPT_FILE — safe
# across families). Gemma probes reuse the battery's pinned gemma ids; every other family
# uses the shared text probe.
# argmax probes run run-gen with MEMRA_NGEN=<ngen>; the gate is (1) the run-gen argmax
# MATCH line + no MISMATCH-STRUCTURED, and (2) the `tokens:` line byte-equal to the pinned
# golden in goldens/<id>.tokens (goldens refresh ONLY at full-battery green points).
# spec probes run run-spec at the single MEMRA_SPEC_K pinned in extra-env (the K=1..8 sweep
# stays tier-2); their gate is the SELF-CONSISTENCY PASS line plus the same golden pin on
# the plain-generate `tokens:` line.
# One model per KERNEL CLASS the dispatch actually forks on (see map.tsv header):
# g12d: DEPTH probe (the battery's 1736-id depth prompt) — the gemma fp8-KV g-module FA arms
# (hd512 dpl16 globals + windowed hd256) actually execute at t_kv ~1740; the 19-id gemma
# probes decode below the t_kv=96 vec floor and never leave the scalar arm. (The ~100-token
# text probes q9/q35/etc DO exercise the default-module v4 hd256 arm already.)
# ngen=16, NOT 20: g12 depth prime is run-to-run NONDETERMINISTIC at a near-tie — token 17
# flips 107<->45518 (~1/8 runs, prefill logit maxdiff 2.438 vs 2.492 run-to-run; receipts
# research/fast-gate-20260802/g12-depth-nondeterminism.log). The first 16 generated ids were
# stable across every observed run; a 20-token golden false-fails ~1/8.
g12d
e4b
q9
# k27 pins MEMRA_FA_SPLIT=8 (lane/k27-divergence, research/k27-divergence-20260805/VERDICT.md):
# goldens are minted on the 82-SM 5090 whose fa_split_keys ladder gives split 8 at this probe's
# t_kv (96-110); any rig with fa_sm_count()>=128 defaults to split 16 = different FA-decode
# split-K reduction segmentation, and generated index 6 sits at t_kv=96 (the vec floor) on a
# near-tie (margin 0.04 vs step-median ~9.4) that the split size flips — the v0.70.0 release
# battery's pod red. The pin is a NO-OP on the 5090 (default already 8 here, md5-verified) and
# makes the probe test the same arithmetic the golden was minted under on every rig. Cross-rig
# TF logs at matched split are byte-identical to every printed digit — no silicon/toolkit gap.
# q35 chat-wrapped: the raw continuation hits EOS after 1 token (a 1-id golden is no net).
# q35slru: SAME model FORCED into the spill regime — MEMRA_MOE_RESIDENT=0 kills the resident
# slabs AND MEMRA_MOE_SLOTS=1024 caps the SLRU below the bank (~1GB vs 15.6GB), so prewarm can
# cover only layer 0 and every other layer rides the staged miss path (SLRU dispatch, eviction,
# H2D staging, moe_cached_gemm*). On a 24GB rig every resident-fitting probe (q35, g26, o35,
# kat) NEVER exercises that dispatch class — a break there was demonstrably invisible to the
# plain q35 probe (research/fast-gate-20260802/break-moe-staged-*). Uncapped RESIDENT=0 is not
# enough either: the default SLRU budget still swallows the whole bank and the dev-from-slots
# arm serves everything. This probe exists so the moe_cache/spill/staged rows have a probe
# that EXERCISES them.
q35slru
aw35
o9
kat
# spec probes (ONE K each — the K=1..8 sweep is tier-2).
# kind=spec  -> run-spec at MEMRA_SPEC_K (qwen MTP/NextN family); gate = SELF-CONSISTENCY PASS
#               + golden pin on the plain-generate tokens line.
# kind=gspec -> gemma-gate at MEMRA_SPEC (gemma assistant-drafter family, the battery's own
#               invocation); gate = "stream agreement ngen/ngen" (spec self-compares vs plain
#               in the same run — no separate golden needed).
q35spec
# cmd probes (self-gating; exit 0 = PASS). NOTE the greedy blind spot they close: every argmax
# probe runs temp=0, which routes around the sampler chain entirely — a broken sampler or
# spec-sample kernel is INVISIBLE to token goldens (demonstrated in
# research/fast-gate-20260802/break-sampling-*). sample-check oracles spec_sample.cu on-GPU;
# the memra-sampling host chain has its own cargo unit tests.
samp
sampt
g31spec
# chunkinv/chunkinvc: chunked-prefill reduction-order stability (lane/chunk-invariance ->
# lane/chunkinv-flip, research/chunk{-invariance,inv-flip}-20260805). The grain-free fix
# dropped the base_len==0 f32 special case, so prefill is chunk-INVARIANT BY DEFAULT (naked
# env, byte-identical logits across MEMRA_PRIME_CHUNK values). `chunkinv` asserts that
# byte-identity with NO env; `chunkinvc` is its canary — it INJECTS a break (turns the
# MEMRA_PRIME_F32CHUNK0 legacy-arithmetic rollback seam ON, which restores the chunk-variant
# class edge) and PASSES only if that breaks the expect-invariant assertion, so the gate is
# proven able to detect the mechanism (vLLM #40372's pattern: pin the property with an
# asserted test, not a prose note). A canary that flipped only the EXPECTED label would be
# perfectly correlated with the default gate and prove nothing — that trap is documented in the
# gate script's header because this lane wrote it wrong twice.
chunkinv
chunkinvc
# gwstress: the MEMRA_GRAPH_WARMUPS=1 pool-growth adversarial gate (lane/graph-warmups) —
# large<->small session cycles + overlap arm force captures over freed async-pool blocks;
# bit-identity vs eager is the arbiter (#68's class corrupts without faulting) and the
# canary arm proves the comparator can catch injected graph-memory corruption. ~1 min (q9,
# 3 cycles at tier-1; local-ci runs the full 10). Guards capture_graph + the GraphSession
# capture/recapture path.
gwstress
